title: The Apostle's Doctrine and the Practical Path of the Soul
summary: The apostolic teaching applied to the soul's practical path: the Eight Places of the Living Fire (divine love at every level); the Apostle's peace as cosmic letters between the heights and the molded man; the Four Great Kingdoms of the world as the ceiling of natural dominion; the Four Great Works of Sin and the Apostle's separation of Light from Darkness received as faith; the daily purification of the soul through nourishment and the two faces of the heavenly prosopon; the pearl in the sea as the soul molded into a New Man by drops from above; the two luminaries as the only gate of rest for the soul in affliction; and the eight paths drawn from the Zone, ascending to life or pouring into Gehenna.
organizing_principle: The apostolic application — how the doctrine reaches the soul in practice. The section moves from the Living Fire and apostolic letters through the diagnosis of the world's four kingdoms and four works of Sin, into the daily regenerative process and finally the choice of paths for the soul.
